## Dual-Tier Split
- Free Public Gate (`genesiscode2026/velqiris@v1`): stdio runtime gate (`PROC_START`, `PROTO_INIT`, `TOOLS_SCHEMA`, `TOOL_RISK_REVIEW`, `UNKNOWN_TOOL`, `CONCURRENCY`, `PROTOCOL_PURITY`, `CAPTURE_BOUNDS`) with `PASS` / `REVIEW` / `FAIL` summary.
- Commercial Signed Bundle (`v2.2.0`, 79 USDC): adds composite GitHub Action uploading `report.json`, `report.md`, and `manifest.sha256.json`, 10-class secret redaction (`anthropic-key`, `openai-key`, `github-token`, `aws-access-key`, `slack-token`, `stripe-key`, `postgres-uri`, `private-key`, `bearer-token`, `jwt`), bounded static source scan (`--source`), local funnel event logging, and Chitara Trading internal commercial license.
